subject: Ice Armor
text: Ice armors provide protection against Fire, and Fire armors provide protection against Ice.

evidence.quote:
Ice armors provide protection against Fire, and Fire armors likewise against 
Ice.

subject: Ribbon
text: The Ribbon grants protection against all elements.

evidence.quote: The Ribbon also gives protection against all the elements.

subject: Aegis Shield
text: The Aegis Shield provides protection against poison status when it is not inflicted by a regular attack.

evidence.quote:
Also, I read 
on Ben Siron's FF1 Handbook that the Aegis Shield provides protection against 
poison status, as long as it is not inflicted with the regular attack.

subject: Spiked Square
text: Stepping on a spiked square in a cave or tower always triggers a battle every time.

evidence.quote:
Spiked Square-  Normally, you will encounter enemies randomly if you are in a 
cave or tower.  However, sometimes, there are special squares where you can step 
where you will always find the same battle, every time you step there.
